## Purpose and modeling approach

The objective is to predict whether an applicant will have payment difficulties. Because only about 8% of applicants default, accuracy alone can reward a model that almost always predicts the majority class. I therefore use stratified three-fold cross-validation and select models using ROC AUC, the competition metric.

This version is designed for a Mac with a limited R installation. It uses base R plus only `data.table`, `glmnet`, `randomForest`, `gbm`, and `knitr`. The reusable script implements preprocessing, folds, AUC, class sampling, randomized tuning, and model importance directly.

The workflow prevents leakage in four ways:

1. Imputation, category frequency encoding, centering, and scaling are estimated on each training fold and then applied to its validation fold.
2. Up- or downsampling is applied only to a training fold.
3. The competition test set is not used for model selection.
4. Historical records are aggregated to one row per current applicant before joining.

```{r}
# This standalone notebook is intended to be saved in the project root.
project_root <- "."
project_path <- function(path) file.path(project_root, path)

# Reusable modeling functions are embedded here so no external R script is needed.
# Lightweight reusable modeling functions for Home Credit Default Risk.
# External dependencies are limited to required_modeling_packages() below.

`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0L) y else x
}

required_modeling_packages <- function() {
  c("data.table", "glmnet", "randomForest", "gbm", "knitr")
}

check_modeling_packages <- function(packages = required_modeling_packages()) {
  missing <- packages[!vapply(packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Missing R packages: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
        ". Install them in the R Console with: ",
        "install.packages(c('data.table', 'glmnet', 'randomForest', 'gbm', 'knitr'))."
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

  models_dir = "models",

  dir.create(models_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  invisible(list(outputs_dir = outputs_dir, models_dir = models_dir))

assert_columns <- function(data, required, data_name = deparse(substitute(data))) {
  missing <- setdiff(required, names(data))
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    stop(data_name, " is missing required columns: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

safe_divide <- function(numerator, denominator) {
  result <- rep(NA_real_, length(numerator))
  valid <- is.finite(numerator) & is.finite(denominator) & denominator != 0
  result[valid] <- numerator[valid] / denominator[valid]
  result
}

mean_or_na <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
max_or_na <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
min_or_na <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
sum_or_na <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)

weighted_mean_or_na <- function(x, weights) {
  valid <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(weights) & weights > 0
  if (!any(valid)) NA_real_ else stats::weighted.mean(x[valid], weights[valid])
}

find_home_credit_file <- function(data_dir, file_name, required = FALSE) {
  exact <- file.path(data_dir, file_name)
  if (file.exists(exact)) return(exact)
  stem <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(file_name)
  extension <- tools::file_ext(file_name)
  pattern <- paste0("^", stem, "(\\([0-9]+\\))?\\.", extension, "$")
  matches <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(matches) > 0L) return(sort(matches)[[1]])
  if (required) {
    stop("Required file not found: ", file_name, ". Place it in ",
         data_dir, ".", call. = FALSE)
  }
  NULL
}

available_home_credit_files <- function(data_dir) {
  result <- data.frame(
    file = c(
      "application_train.csv", "application_test.csv", "bureau.csv",
      "bureau_balance.csv", "previous_application.csv", "installments_payments.csv",
      "POS_CASH_balance.csv", "credit_card_balance.csv",
      "HomeCredit_columns_description.csv", "sample_submission.csv"
    ),
    grain = c(
      "One current application", "One current application", "One external bureau credit",
      "One month per external bureau credit", "One previous Home Credit application",
      "One payment or missed installment", "One month per previous POS/cash loan",
      "One month per previous credit card", "One column definition",
      "One test-set prediction"
    ),
    primary_key = c(
      "SK_ID_CURR", "SK_ID_CURR", "SK_ID_BUREAU",
      "SK_ID_BUREAU + MONTHS_BALANCE", "SK_ID_PREV", "Composite payment record",
      "SK_ID_PREV + MONTHS_BALANCE", "SK_ID_PREV + MONTHS_BALANCE",
      "Table + Row", "SK_ID_CURR"
    ),
    join_key = c(
      "—", "—", "SK_ID_CURR", "SK_ID_BUREAU", "SK_ID_CURR",
      "SK_ID_PREV and SK_ID_CURR", "SK_ID_PREV and SK_ID_CURR",
      "SK_ID_PREV and SK_ID_CURR", "—", "SK_ID_CURR"
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  result$path <- vapply(result$file, function(x) {
    find_home_credit_file(data_dir, x, required = FALSE) %||% NA_character_
  }, character(1))
  result$available <- !is.na(result$path)
  result
}

find_application_pair <- function(raw_dir, processed_dir = "data/processed") {
  raw_train <- find_home_credit_file(raw_dir, "application_train.csv", required = FALSE)
  raw_test <- find_home_credit_file(raw_dir, "application_test.csv", required = FALSE)
  train_candidates <- c(
    file.path(processed_dir, "application_train_prepared.csv"),
    file.path(processed_dir, "application_train_processed.csv"),
    file.path(processed_dir, "application_train.csv"), raw_train
  )
  test_candidates <- c(
    file.path(processed_dir, "application_test_prepared.csv"),
    file.path(processed_dir, "application_test_processed.csv"),
    file.path(processed_dir, "application_test.csv"), raw_test
  )
  first_existing <- function(paths) {
    found <- paths[!is.na(paths) & file.exists(paths)]
    if (length(found) == 0L) NULL else found[[1]]
  }
  train_path <- first_existing(train_candidates)
  test_path <- first_existing(test_candidates)
  if (is.null(train_path) || is.null(test_path)) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "The notebook requires application_train.csv and application_test.csv",
        "or prepared equivalents in data/processed. Place them in data/raw",
        "before rendering the notebook."
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  list(train = train_path, test = test_path)
}

read_application_data <- function(raw_dir = "data/raw", processed_dir = "data/processed") {
  paths <- find_application_pair(raw_dir, processed_dir)
  train <- data.table::fread(paths$train, data.table = FALSE, showProgress = FALSE)
  test <- data.table::fread(paths$test, data.table = FALSE, showProgress = FALSE)
  assert_columns(train, c("SK_ID_CURR", "TARGET"), "training data")
  assert_columns(test, "SK_ID_CURR", "test data")
  list(train = train, test = test, paths = paths)
}

engineer_application_features <- function(data) {
  output <- as.data.frame(data, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if ("DAYS_EMPLOYED" %in% names(output)) {
    output$DAYS_EMPLOYED[output$DAYS_EMPLOYED == 365243] <- NA_real_
    output$EMPLOYED_YEARS <- abs(output$DAYS_EMPLOYED) / 365.25
  }
  if ("DAYS_BIRTH" %in% names(output)) output$AGE_YEARS <- abs(output$DAYS_BIRTH) / 365.25
  if ("DAYS_REGISTRATION" %in% names(output)) {
    output$REGISTRATION_YEARS <- abs(output$DAYS_REGISTRATION) / 365.25
  }
  if ("DAYS_ID_PUBLISH" %in% names(output)) {
    output$ID_PUBLISH_YEARS <- abs(output$DAYS_ID_PUBLISH) / 365.25
  }
  ratio_specs <- list(
    CREDIT_TO_INCOME = c("AMT_CREDIT", "AMT_INCOME_TOTAL"),
    ANNUITY_TO_INCOME = c("AMT_ANNUITY", "AMT_INCOME_TOTAL"),
    GOODS_TO_CREDIT = c("AMT_GOODS_PRICE", "AMT_CREDIT"),
    PAYMENT_RATE = c("AMT_ANNUITY", "AMT_CREDIT"),
    INCOME_PER_PERSON = c("AMT_INCOME_TOTAL", "CNT_FAM_MEMBERS"),
    EMPLOYED_TO_AGE = c("EMPLOYED_YEARS", "AGE_YEARS")
  )
  for (new_name in names(ratio_specs)) {
    inputs <- ratio_specs[[new_name]]
    if (all(inputs %in% names(output))) {
      output[[new_name]] <- safe_divide(output[[inputs[[1]]]], output[[inputs[[2]]]])
    }
  }
  ext_sources <- intersect(c("EXT_SOURCE_1", "EXT_SOURCE_2", "EXT_SOURCE_3"), names(output))
  if (length(ext_sources) > 0L) {
    ext_matrix <- as.matrix(output[, ext_sources, drop = FALSE])
    output$EXT_SOURCE_MEAN <- rowMeans(ext_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)
    output$EXT_SOURCE_MEAN[!is.finite(output$EXT_SOURCE_MEAN)] <- NA_real_
    output$EXT_SOURCE_MISSING <- rowSums(is.na(ext_matrix))
  }
  predictor_names <- setdiff(names(output), c("TARGET", "SK_ID_CURR"))
  output$APPLICATION_MISSING_COUNT <- rowSums(is.na(output[, predictor_names, drop = FALSE]))
  output
}

coerce_target <- function(train) {
  assert_columns(train, "TARGET", "training data")
  target <- train$TARGET
  if (is.factor(target) || is.character(target)) {
    target_text <- as.character(target)
    if (all(target_text %in% c("default", "non_default"))) {
      target <- ifelse(target_text == "default", 1L, 0L)
    } else {
      target <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(target_text))
    }
  } else {
    target <- as.integer(target)
  }
  if (any(is.na(target)) || any(!target %in% c(0L, 1L))) {
    stop("TARGET must contain only 0/1 or default/non_default.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  train$TARGET <- target
  train
}

harmonize_train_test <- function(train, test) {
  train <- coerce_target(train)
  if ("TARGET" %in% names(test)) test$TARGET <- NULL
  train_predictors <- setdiff(names(train), "TARGET")
  missing_in_test <- setdiff(train_predictors, names(test))
  for (column in missing_in_test) test[[column]] <- NA
  extra_in_test <- setdiff(names(test), train_predictors)
  if (length(extra_in_test) > 0L) test[extra_in_test] <- NULL
  test <- test[, train_predictors, drop = FALSE]
  list(train = train, test = test)
}

aggregate_bureau_features <- function(data_dir, include_balance = FALSE) {
  bureau_path <- find_home_credit_file(data_dir, "bureau.csv", required = TRUE)
  bureau <- data.table::fread(bureau_path, showProgress = FALSE)
  assert_columns(bureau, c("SK_ID_CURR", "SK_ID_BUREAU"), "bureau.csv")
  bureau <- bureau[is.na(DAYS_CREDIT) | DAYS_CREDIT <= 0]
  bureau[, BUREAU_DEBT_RATIO_ROW := safe_divide(AMT_CREDIT_SUM_DEBT, AMT_CREDIT_SUM)]
  bureau_features <- bureau[, .(
    BUREAU_CREDIT_COUNT = .N,
    BUREAU_ACTIVE_COUNT = sum(CREDIT_ACTIVE == "Active", na.rm = TRUE),
    BUREAU_CLOSED_COUNT = sum(CREDIT_ACTIVE == "Closed", na.rm = TRUE),
    BUREAU_BAD_DEBT_COUNT = sum(CREDIT_ACTIVE == "Bad debt", na.rm = TRUE),
    BUREAU_ACTIVE_SHARE = mean_or_na(CREDIT_ACTIVE == "Active"),
    BUREAU_DAYS_CREDIT_MEAN = mean_or_na(DAYS_CREDIT),
    BUREAU_DAYS_CREDIT_OLDEST = min_or_na(DAYS_CREDIT),
    BUREAU_DAYS_CREDIT_RECENT = max_or_na(DAYS_CREDIT),
    BUREAU_OVERDUE_DAYS_MAX = max_or_na(CREDIT_DAY_OVERDUE),
    BUREAU_ANY_OVERDUE_SHARE = mean_or_na(CREDIT_DAY_OVERDUE > 0),
    BUREAU_CREDIT_SUM_TOTAL = sum_or_na(AMT_CREDIT_SUM),
    BUREAU_CREDIT_SUM_MEAN = mean_or_na(AMT_CREDIT_SUM),
    BUREAU_DEBT_TOTAL = sum_or_na(AMT_CREDIT_SUM_DEBT),
    BUREAU_DEBT_RATIO_MEAN = mean_or_na(BUREAU_DEBT_RATIO_ROW),
    BUREAU_OVERDUE_AMOUNT_MAX = max_or_na(AMT_CREDIT_SUM_OVERDUE),
    BUREAU_PROLONG_COUNT = sum_or_na(CNT_CREDIT_PROLONG)
  ), by = SK_ID_CURR]
  if (!include_balance) return(as.data.frame(bureau_features))
  balance_path <- find_home_credit_file(data_dir, "bureau_balance.csv", required = FALSE)
  if (is.null(balance_path)) return(as.data.frame(bureau_features))
  bureau_balance <- data.table::fread(
    balance_path,
    select = c("SK_ID_BUREAU", "MONTHS_BALANCE", "STATUS"),
    showProgress = FALSE
  )
  bureau_balance <- bureau_balance[is.na(MONTHS_BALANCE) | MONTHS_BALANCE <= 0]
  bureau_balance[, STATUS_NUMERIC := suppressWarnings(as.integer(STATUS))]
  by_account <- bureau_balance[, .(
    BB_OBSERVATIONS = .N,
    BB_MONTHS_OLDEST = min_or_na(MONTHS_BALANCE),
    BB_MONTHS_RECENT = max_or_na(MONTHS_BALANCE),
    BB_CURRENT_SHARE = mean_or_na(STATUS == "C"),
    BB_UNKNOWN_SHARE = mean_or_na(STATUS == "X"),
    BB_DELINQUENT_SHARE = mean_or_na(STATUS %in% as.character(1:5)),
    BB_SEVERE_DELINQUENT_SHARE = mean_or_na(STATUS %in% as.character(3:5)),
    BB_STATUS_MAX = max_or_na(STATUS_NUMERIC)
  ), by = SK_ID_BUREAU]
  bureau_map <- unique(bureau[, .(SK_ID_BUREAU, SK_ID_CURR)])
  by_account <- merge(by_account, bureau_map, by = "SK_ID_BUREAU", all.x = TRUE)
  by_current <- by_account[!is.na(SK_ID_CURR), .(
    BB_ACCOUNT_COUNT = .N,
    BB_RECORDS = sum(BB_OBSERVATIONS, na.rm = TRUE),
    BB_MONTHS_OLDEST = min_or_na(BB_MONTHS_OLDEST),
    BB_MONTHS_RECENT = max_or_na(BB_MONTHS_RECENT),
    BB_CURRENT_SHARE = weighted_mean_or_na(BB_CURRENT_SHARE, BB_OBSERVATIONS),
    BB_UNKNOWN_SHARE = weighted_mean_or_na(BB_UNKNOWN_SHARE, BB_OBSERVATIONS),
    BB_DELINQUENT_SHARE = weighted_mean_or_na(BB_DELINQUENT_SHARE, BB_OBSERVATIONS),
    BB_SEVERE_DELINQUENT_SHARE = weighted_mean_or_na(BB_SEVERE_DELINQUENT_SHARE, BB_OBSERVATIONS),
    BB_STATUS_MAX = max_or_na(BB_STATUS_MAX)
  ), by = SK_ID_CURR]
  as.data.frame(merge(bureau_features, by_current, by = "SK_ID_CURR", all.x = TRUE))
}

aggregate_credit_card_features <- function(data_dir) {
  path <- find_home_credit_file(data_dir, "credit_card_balance.csv", required = TRUE)
  columns <- c(
    "SK_ID_PREV", "SK_ID_CURR", "MONTHS_BALANCE", "AMT_BALANCE",
    "AMT_CREDIT_LIMIT_ACTUAL", "AMT_DRAWINGS_CURRENT", "AMT_INST_MIN_REGULARITY",
    "AMT_PAYMENT_TOTAL_CURRENT", "AMT_TOTAL_RECEIVABLE", "CNT_DRAWINGS_CURRENT",
    "NAME_CONTRACT_STATUS", "SK_DPD", "SK_DPD_DEF"
  )
  cc <- data.table::fread(path, select = columns, showProgress = FALSE)
  cc <- cc[is.na(MONTHS_BALANCE) | MONTHS_BALANCE <= 0]
  cc[, CC_UTILIZATION_ROW := safe_divide(AMT_BALANCE, AMT_CREDIT_LIMIT_ACTUAL)]
  cc[, CC_PAYMENT_RATIO_ROW := safe_divide(AMT_PAYMENT_TOTAL_CURRENT, AMT_INST_MIN_REGULARITY)]
  features <- cc[, .(
    CC_RECORDS = .N,
    CC_CONTRACT_COUNT = data.table::uniqueN(SK_ID_PREV),
    CC_MONTHS_OLDEST = min_or_na(MONTHS_BALANCE),
    CC_MONTHS_RECENT = max_or_na(MONTHS_BALANCE),
    CC_BALANCE_MEAN = mean_or_na(AMT_BALANCE),
    CC_BALANCE_MAX = max_or_na(AMT_BALANCE),
    CC_CREDIT_LIMIT_MEAN = mean_or_na(AMT_CREDIT_LIMIT_ACTUAL),
    CC_UTILIZATION_MEAN = mean_or_na(CC_UTILIZATION_ROW),
    CC_UTILIZATION_MAX = max_or_na(CC_UTILIZATION_ROW),
    CC_DRAWINGS_TOTAL = sum_or_na(AMT_DRAWINGS_CURRENT),
    CC_DRAWING_COUNT_TOTAL = sum_or_na(CNT_DRAWINGS_CURRENT),
    CC_PAYMENT_TOTAL = sum_or_na(AMT_PAYMENT_TOTAL_CURRENT),
    CC_PAYMENT_RATIO_MEAN = mean_or_na(CC_PAYMENT_RATIO_ROW),
    CC_RECEIVABLE_MEAN = mean_or_na(AMT_TOTAL_RECEIVABLE),
    CC_DPD_MAX = max_or_na(SK_DPD),
    CC_DPD_DEF_MAX = max_or_na(SK_DPD_DEF),
    CC_ANY_DPD_SHARE = mean_or_na(SK_DPD > 0),
    CC_COMPLETED_SHARE = mean_or_na(NAME_CONTRACT_STATUS == "Completed")
  ), by = SK_ID_CURR]
  as.data.frame(features)
}

aggregate_previous_application_features <- function(data_dir) {
  path <- find_home_credit_file(data_dir, "previous_application.csv", required = TRUE)
  previous <- data.table::fread(path, showProgress = FALSE)
  assert_columns(previous, c("SK_ID_CURR", "SK_ID_PREV"), "previous_application.csv")
  previous <- previous[is.na(DAYS_DECISION) | DAYS_DECISION <= 0]
  previous[, PREV_CREDIT_TO_APPLICATION_ROW := safe_divide(AMT_CREDIT, AMT_APPLICATION)]
  features <- previous[, .(
    PREV_APPLICATION_COUNT = .N,
    PREV_CONTRACT_COUNT = data.table::uniqueN(SK_ID_PREV),
    PREV_APPROVED_COUNT = sum(NAME_CONTRACT_STATUS == "Approved", na.rm = TRUE),
    PREV_REFUSED_COUNT = sum(NAME_CONTRACT_STATUS == "Refused", na.rm = TRUE),
    PREV_APPROVED_SHARE = mean_or_na(NAME_CONTRACT_STATUS == "Approved"),
    PREV_REFUSED_SHARE = mean_or_na(NAME_CONTRACT_STATUS == "Refused"),
    PREV_APPLICATION_AMOUNT_MEAN = mean_or_na(AMT_APPLICATION),
    PREV_CREDIT_AMOUNT_MEAN = mean_or_na(AMT_CREDIT),
    PREV_ANNUITY_MEAN = mean_or_na(AMT_ANNUITY),
    PREV_DOWN_PAYMENT_MEAN = mean_or_na(AMT_DOWN_PAYMENT),
    PREV_CREDIT_TO_APPLICATION_MEAN = mean_or_na(PREV_CREDIT_TO_APPLICATION_ROW),
    PREV_DAYS_DECISION_RECENT = max_or_na(DAYS_DECISION),
    PREV_DAYS_DECISION_OLDEST = min_or_na(DAYS_DECISION),
    PREV_CLIENT_TYPE_REPEAT_SHARE = mean_or_na(NAME_CLIENT_TYPE == "Repeater")
  ), by = SK_ID_CURR]
  as.data.frame(features)
}

aggregate_installment_features <- function(data_dir) {
  path <- find_home_credit_file(data_dir, "installments_payments.csv", required = TRUE)
  installments <- data.table::fread(path, showProgress = FALSE)
  assert_columns(installments, c("SK_ID_CURR", "SK_ID_PREV"), "installments_payments.csv")
  installments <- installments[
    (is.na(DAYS_ENTRY_PAYMENT) | DAYS_ENTRY_PAYMENT <= 0) &
      (is.na(DAYS_INSTALMENT) | DAYS_INSTALMENT <= 0)
  ]
  installments[, INST_DAYS_LATE_ROW := DAYS_ENTRY_PAYMENT - DAYS_INSTALMENT]
  installments[, INST_PAYMENT_RATIO_ROW := safe_divide(AMT_PAYMENT, AMT_INSTALMENT)]
  installments[, INST_SHORTFALL_ROW := ifelse(
    is.na(AMT_INSTALMENT) | is.na(AMT_PAYMENT), NA_real_,
    pmax(AMT_INSTALMENT - AMT_PAYMENT, 0)
  )]
  installments[, INST_DAYS_LATE_POSITIVE := ifelse(
    is.na(INST_DAYS_LATE_ROW), NA_real_, pmax(INST_DAYS_LATE_ROW, 0)
  )]
  features <- installments[, .(
    INST_RECORDS = .N,
    INST_CONTRACT_COUNT = data.table::uniqueN(SK_ID_PREV),
    INST_LATE_SHARE = mean_or_na(INST_DAYS_LATE_ROW > 0),
    INST_DAYS_LATE_MEAN = mean_or_na(INST_DAYS_LATE_POSITIVE),
    INST_DAYS_LATE_MAX = max_or_na(INST_DAYS_LATE_POSITIVE),
    INST_PAYMENT_RATIO_MEAN = mean_or_na(INST_PAYMENT_RATIO_ROW),
    INST_SHORTFALL_TOTAL = sum_or_na(INST_SHORTFALL_ROW),
    INST_PAYMENT_TOTAL = sum_or_na(AMT_PAYMENT),
    INST_AMOUNT_TOTAL = sum_or_na(AMT_INSTALMENT)
  ), by = SK_ID_CURR]
  as.data.frame(features)
}

aggregate_pos_cash_features <- function(data_dir) {
  path <- find_home_credit_file(data_dir, "POS_CASH_balance.csv", required = TRUE)
  pos <- data.table::fread(path, showProgress = FALSE)
  assert_columns(pos, c("SK_ID_CURR", "SK_ID_PREV"), "POS_CASH_balance.csv")
  pos <- pos[is.na(MONTHS_BALANCE) | MONTHS_BALANCE <= 0]
  features <- pos[, .(
    POS_RECORDS = .N,
    POS_CONTRACT_COUNT = data.table::uniqueN(SK_ID_PREV),
    POS_MONTHS_OLDEST = min_or_na(MONTHS_BALANCE),
    POS_MONTHS_RECENT = max_or_na(MONTHS_BALANCE),
    POS_DPD_MEAN = mean_or_na(SK_DPD),
    POS_DPD_MAX = max_or_na(SK_DPD),
    POS_DPD_DEF_MAX = max_or_na(SK_DPD_DEF),
    POS_ANY_DPD_SHARE = mean_or_na(SK_DPD > 0),
    POS_INSTALLMENTS_FUTURE_MEAN = mean_or_na(CNT_INSTALMENT_FUTURE),
    POS_COMPLETED_SHARE = mean_or_na(NAME_CONTRACT_STATUS == "Completed")
  ), by = SK_ID_CURR]
  as.data.frame(features)
}

build_supplementary_features <- function(data_dir, include_bureau_balance = FALSE) {
  feature_sets <- list()
  sources <- character()
  if (!is.null(find_home_credit_file(data_dir, "bureau.csv", required = FALSE))) {
    feature_sets$bureau <- aggregate_bureau_features(data_dir, include_bureau_balance)
    sources <- c(sources, "bureau.csv")
    if (include_bureau_balance &&
        !is.null(find_home_credit_file(data_dir, "bureau_balance.csv", required = FALSE))) {
      sources <- c(sources, "bureau_balance.csv")
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(find_home_credit_file(data_dir, "previous_application.csv", required = FALSE))) {
    feature_sets$previous <- aggregate_previous_application_features(data_dir)
    sources <- c(sources, "previous_application.csv")
  }
  if (!is.null(find_home_credit_file(data_dir, "installments_payments.csv", required = FALSE))) {
    feature_sets$installments <- aggregate_installment_features(data_dir)
    sources <- c(sources, "installments_payments.csv")
  }
  if (!is.null(find_home_credit_file(data_dir, "POS_CASH_balance.csv", required = FALSE))) {
    feature_sets$pos <- aggregate_pos_cash_features(data_dir)
    sources <- c(sources, "POS_CASH_balance.csv")
  }
  if (!is.null(find_home_credit_file(data_dir, "credit_card_balance.csv", required = FALSE))) {
    feature_sets$credit_card <- aggregate_credit_card_features(data_dir)
    sources <- c(sources, "credit_card_balance.csv")
  }
  if (length(feature_sets) == 0L) return(NULL)
  combined <- Reduce(
    function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "SK_ID_CURR", all = TRUE, sort = FALSE),
    feature_sets
  )
  attr(combined, "sources") <- sources
  combined
}

load_or_build_supplementary_features <- function(
    data_dir, cache_path, include_bureau_balance = FALSE) {
  if (file.exists(cache_path)) {
    cached <- data.table::fread(cache_path, data.table = FALSE, showProgress = FALSE)
    attr(cached, "sources") <- "Cached aggregate file"
    return(cached)
  }
  features <- build_supplementary_features(data_dir, include_bureau_balance)
  if (!is.null(features)) {
    dir.create(dirname(cache_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    data.table::fwrite(features, cache_path)
  }
  features
}

add_history_availability <- function(data) {
  prefix_map <- c(
    BUREAU = "BUREAU_", BUREAU_BALANCE = "BB_", PREVIOUS = "PREV_",
    INSTALLMENTS = "INST_", POS_CASH = "POS_", CREDIT_CARD = "CC_"
  )
  output <- data
  for (label in names(prefix_map)) {
    columns <- grep(paste0("^", prefix_map[[label]]), names(output), value = TRUE)
    if (length(columns) == 0L) next
    output[[paste0("HAS_", label, "_HISTORY")]] <- as.integer(
      rowSums(!is.na(output[, columns, drop = FALSE])) > 0L
    )
  }
  count_columns <- grep("(_COUNT|_RECORDS|_OBSERVATIONS)$", names(output), value = TRUE)
  for (column in count_columns) output[[column]][is.na(output[[column]])] <- 0
  output
}

left_join_by_id <- function(data, features, id = "SK_ID_CURR") {
  if (is.null(features)) return(data)
  feature_columns <- setdiff(names(features), id)
  positions <- match(data[[id]], features[[id]])
  joined <- cbind(data, features[positions, feature_columns, drop = FALSE])
  rownames(joined) <- NULL
  joined
}

join_supplementary_features <- function(train, test, supplementary) {
  if (is.null(supplementary)) return(list(train = train, test = test))
  list(
    train = add_history_availability(left_join_by_id(train, supplementary)),
    test = add_history_availability(left_join_by_id(test, supplementary))
  )
}

default_basic_predictors <- function(data) {
  candidates <- c(
    "EXT_SOURCE_1", "EXT_SOURCE_2", "EXT_SOURCE_3", "EXT_SOURCE_MEAN",
    "AGE_YEARS", "EMPLOYED_YEARS", "AMT_INCOME_TOTAL", "AMT_CREDIT",
    "AMT_ANNUITY", "AMT_GOODS_PRICE", "CREDIT_TO_INCOME",
    "ANNUITY_TO_INCOME", "PAYMENT_RATE", "INCOME_PER_PERSON",
    "NAME_EDUCATION_TYPE", "NAME_INCOME_TYPE", "NAME_FAMILY_STATUS",
    "NAME_HOUSING_TYPE", "OCCUPATION_TYPE", "ORGANIZATION_TYPE",
    "CODE_GENDER", "FLAG_OWN_CAR", "FLAG_OWN_REALTY",
    "REGION_RATING_CLIENT", "REGION_RATING_CLIENT_W_CITY"
  )
  intersect(candidates, names(data))
}

predictor_names_for_set <- function(data, predictor_set = c("full", "basic")) {
  predictor_set <- match.arg(predictor_set)
  if (predictor_set == "basic") return(default_basic_predictors(data))
  setdiff(names(data), c("TARGET", "SK_ID_CURR"))
}

encode_column_fit <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x) || is.integer(x) || is.logical(x)) {
    values <- as.numeric(x)
    values[!is.finite(values)] <- NA_real_
    median_value <- if (all(is.na(values))) 0 else stats::median(values, na.rm = TRUE)
    values[is.na(values)] <- median_value
    return(list(kind = "numeric", median = median_value, values = values))
  }
  values <- as.character(x)
  values[is.na(values) | values == ""] <- "__MISSING__"
  frequencies <- table(values) / length(values)
  encoded <- as.numeric(frequencies[values])
  list(kind = "categorical", frequencies = frequencies, values = encoded)
}

fit_preprocessor <- function(data, predictor_set = c("full", "basic")) {
  predictor_set <- match.arg(predictor_set)
  predictors <- predictor_names_for_set(data, predictor_set)
  if (length(predictors) == 0L) stop("No predictors were available.", call. = FALSE)
  encoded <- vector("list", length(predictors))
  names(encoded) <- predictors
  matrix_data <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(data), ncol = length(predictors))
  colnames(matrix_data) <- make.names(predictors, unique = TRUE)
  for (index in seq_along(predictors)) {
    specification <- encode_column_fit(data[[predictors[[index]]]])
    matrix_data[, index] <- specification$values
    specification$values <- NULL
    encoded[[index]] <- specification
  }
  centers <- colMeans(matrix_data)
  second_moment <- colMeans(matrix_data^2)
  scales <- sqrt(pmax(second_moment - centers^2, 0))
  keep <- is.finite(scales) & scales > 1e-8
  if (!any(keep)) stop("All predictors had zero variance.", call. = FALSE)
  list(
    predictor_set = predictor_set, predictors = predictors, encoded = encoded,
    keep = keep, feature_names = colnames(matrix_data)[keep],
    center = centers[keep], scale = scales[keep]
  )
}

transform_preprocessor <- function(preprocessor, data) {
  missing <- setdiff(preprocessor$predictors, names(data))
  if (length(missing) > 0L) for (column in missing) data[[column]] <- NA
  matrix_data <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(data), ncol = length(preprocessor$predictors))
  colnames(matrix_data) <- make.names(preprocessor$predictors, unique = TRUE)
  for (index in seq_along(preprocessor$predictors)) {
    column <- preprocessor$predictors[[index]]
    specification <- preprocessor$encoded[[index]]
    if (specification$kind == "numeric") {
      values <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(data[[column]]))
      values[!is.finite(values)] <- NA_real_
      values[is.na(values)] <- specification$median
    } else {
      values_text <- as.character(data[[column]])
      values_text[is.na(values_text) | values_text == ""] <- "__MISSING__"
      values <- as.numeric(specification$frequencies[values_text])
      values[is.na(values)] <- 0
    }
    matrix_data[, index] <- values
  }
  matrix_data <- matrix_data[, preprocessor$keep, drop = FALSE]
  matrix_data <- sweep(matrix_data, 2L, preprocessor$center, "-")
  matrix_data <- sweep(matrix_data, 2L, preprocessor$scale, "/")
  matrix_data[!is.finite(matrix_data)] <- 0
  matrix_data
}

stratified_sample_rows <- function(data, n, seed = 6601L) {
  n <- min(as.integer(n), nrow(data))
  if (n >= nrow(data)) return(data)
  set.seed(seed)
  classes <- sort(unique(data$TARGET))
  counts <- table(factor(data$TARGET, levels = classes))
  exact <- n * as.numeric(counts) / sum(counts)
  allocation <- floor(exact)
  remainder <- n - sum(allocation)
  if (remainder > 0L) {
    priority <- order(exact - allocation, decreasing = TRUE)
    allocation[priority[seq_len(remainder)]] <- allocation[priority[seq_len(remainder)]] + 1L
  }
  indices <- unlist(lapply(seq_along(classes), function(i) {
    candidates <- which(data$TARGET == classes[[i]])
    sample(candidates, allocation[[i]], replace = FALSE)
  }), use.names = FALSE)
  data[sample(indices), , drop = FALSE]
}

make_stratified_folds <- function(target, v = 3L, seed = 6601L) {
  set.seed(seed)
  folds <- integer(length(target))
  for (value in sort(unique(target))) {
    indices <- sample(which(target == value))
    folds[indices] <- rep(seq_len(v), length.out = length(indices))
  }
  folds
}

roc_auc_score <- function(truth, probability) {
  truth <- as.integer(truth)
  valid <- is.finite(probability) & !is.na(truth)
  truth <- truth[valid]
  probability <- probability[valid]
  positive <- truth == 1L
  n_positive <- sum(positive)
  n_negative <- sum(!positive)
  if (n_positive == 0L || n_negative == 0L) return(NA_real_)
  ranks <- rank(probability, ties.method = "average")
  (sum(ranks[positive]) - n_positive * (n_positive + 1) / 2) /
    (n_positive * n_negative)
}

pr_auc_score <- function(truth, probability) {
  truth <- as.integer(truth)
  valid <- is.finite(probability) & !is.na(truth)
  truth <- truth[valid]
  probability <- probability[valid]
  if (sum(truth == 1L) == 0L) return(NA_real_)
  order_index <- order(probability, decreasing = TRUE)
  ordered_truth <- truth[order_index]
  cumulative_positive <- cumsum(ordered_truth == 1L)
  precision <- cumulative_positive / seq_along(ordered_truth)
  mean(precision[ordered_truth == 1L])
}

classification_metrics <- function(truth, probability, threshold = 0.5) {
  prediction <- as.integer(probability >= threshold)
  true_positive <- sum(prediction == 1L & truth == 1L)
  true_negative <- sum(prediction == 0L & truth == 0L)
  false_positive <- sum(prediction == 1L & truth == 0L)
  false_negative <- sum(prediction == 0L & truth == 1L)
  data.frame(
    roc_auc = roc_auc_score(truth, probability),
    pr_auc = pr_auc_score(truth, probability),
    accuracy = mean(prediction == truth),
    sensitivity = if ((true_positive + false_negative) == 0) NA_real_ else
      true_positive / (true_positive + false_negative),
    specificity = if ((true_negative + false_positive) == 0) NA_real_ else
      true_negative / (true_negative + false_positive)
  )
}

baseline_metrics <- function(train) {
  train <- coerce_target(train)
  default_rate <- mean(train$TARGET == 1L)
  data.frame(
    model_label = "Majority-class classifier",
    metric = c("Accuracy", "ROC AUC", "PR AUC"),
    estimate = c(1 - default_rate, 0.5, default_rate),
    meaning = c(
      "Predict every applicant as non-default.",
      "Constant scores have no ranking ability.",
      "For a constant ranking, precision equals event prevalence."
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

balance_training_data <- function(x, y, strategy = c("none", "downsample", "upsample"), seed = 6601L) {
  strategy <- match.arg(strategy)
  if (strategy == "none") return(list(x = x, y = y))
  set.seed(seed)
  negative <- which(y == 0L)
  positive <- which(y == 1L)
  if (length(negative) == 0L || length(positive) == 0L) {
    stop("Both target classes are required for balancing.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (strategy == "downsample") {
    size <- min(length(negative), length(positive))
    indices <- c(sample(negative, size), sample(positive, size))
  } else {
    size <- max(length(negative), length(positive))
    indices <- c(
      sample(negative, size, replace = length(negative) < size),
      sample(positive, size, replace = length(positive) < size)
    )
  }
  indices <- sample(indices)
  list(x = x[indices, , drop = FALSE], y = y[indices])
}

candidate_registry <- function() {
  data.frame(
    model_id = c(
      "logistic_basic_none", "elastic_net_full_none", "random_forest_full_none",
      "gbm_full_none", "gbm_full_downsample", "gbm_full_upsample"
    ),
    model_label = c(
      "Logistic regression: basic predictors", "Elastic-net logistic regression",
      "Random forest", "Gradient boosting", "Gradient boosting with downsampling",
      "Gradient boosting with upsampling"
    ),
    algorithm = c("logistic", "elastic_net", "random_forest", "gbm", "gbm", "gbm"),
    predictor_set = c("basic", "full", "full", "full", "full", "full"),
    imbalance = c("none", "none", "none", "none", "downsample", "upsample"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

default_model_parameters <- function(algorithm, predictor_count) {
  if (algorithm == "logistic") return(list(maxit = 100L))
  if (algorithm == "elastic_net") return(list(alpha = 0.5, lambda = 0.01))
  if (algorithm == "random_forest") {
    return(list(
      ntree = 300L,
      mtry = max(2L, min(predictor_count, round(sqrt(predictor_count)))),
      nodesize = 20L
    ))
  }
  if (algorithm == "gbm") {
    return(list(
      n.trees = 400L, interaction.depth = 5L, shrinkage = 0.05,
      n.minobsinnode = 20L, bag.fraction = 0.8
    ))
  }
  stop("Unsupported algorithm: ", algorithm, call. = FALSE)
}

fit_algorithm <- function(x, y, algorithm, parameters = NULL, seed = 6601L) {
  set.seed(seed)
  parameters <- parameters %||% default_model_parameters(algorithm, ncol(x))
  if (algorithm == "logistic") {
    design <- cbind(`(Intercept)` = 1, x)
    fitted <- suppressWarnings(stats::glm.fit(
      x = design, y = y, family = stats::binomial(),
      control = stats::glm.control(maxit = parameters$maxit %||% 100L)
    ))
    coefficients <- fitted$coefficients
    coefficients[!is.finite(coefficients)] <- 0
    return(list(algorithm = algorithm, fit = fitted, coefficients = coefficients, parameters = parameters))
  }
  if (algorithm == "elastic_net") {
    fitted <- glmnet::glmnet(
      x = x, y = y, family = "binomial", alpha = parameters$alpha,
      lambda = parameters$lambda, standardize = FALSE
    )
    return(list(algorithm = algorithm, fit = fitted, parameters = parameters))
  }
  if (algorithm == "random_forest") {
    fitted <- randomForest::randomForest(
      x = x, y = factor(y, levels = c(0, 1)), ntree = as.integer(parameters$ntree),
      mtry = as.integer(min(parameters$mtry, ncol(x))),
      nodesize = as.integer(parameters$nodesize), importance = TRUE
    )
    return(list(algorithm = algorithm, fit = fitted, parameters = parameters))
  }
  if (algorithm == "gbm") {
    fitted <- gbm::gbm.fit(
      x = x, y = y, distribution = "bernoulli",
      n.trees = as.integer(parameters$n.trees),
      interaction.depth = as.integer(parameters$interaction.depth),
      n.minobsinnode = as.integer(parameters$n.minobsinnode),
      shrinkage = parameters$shrinkage, bag.fraction = parameters$bag.fraction,
      nTrain = nrow(x), 
      keep.data = FALSE, 
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    return(list(algorithm = algorithm, fit = fitted, parameters = parameters))
  }
  stop("Unsupported algorithm: ", algorithm, call. = FALSE)
}

predict_algorithm <- function(model, new_x) {
  if (model$algorithm == "logistic") {
    design <- cbind(`(Intercept)` = 1, new_x)
    probability <- stats::plogis(drop(design %*% model$coefficients))
  } else if (model$algorithm == "elastic_net") {
    probability <- drop(stats::predict(
      model$fit, newx = new_x, s = model$parameters$lambda, type = "response"
    ))
  } else if (model$algorithm == "random_forest") {
    probability <- stats::predict(model$fit, newdata = new_x, type = "prob")[, "1"]
  } else if (model$algorithm == "gbm") {
    probability <- drop(stats::predict(
      model$fit, newdata = new_x, n.trees = model$parameters$n.trees,
      type = "response"
    ))
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported algorithm: ", model$algorithm, call. = FALSE)
  }
  pmin(pmax(as.numeric(probability), 1e-7), 1 - 1e-7)
}

cross_validate_config <- function(data, config, v = 3L, seed = 6601L) {
  folds <- make_stratified_folds(data$TARGET, v = v, seed = seed)
  fold_metrics <- vector("list", v)
  predictions <- vector("list", v)
  for (fold in seq_len(v)) {
    analysis_rows <- folds != fold
    assessment_rows <- folds == fold
    preprocessor <- fit_preprocessor(
      data[analysis_rows, , drop = FALSE], config$predictor_set[[1]]
    )
    analysis_x <- transform_preprocessor(preprocessor, data[analysis_rows, , drop = FALSE])
    assessment_x <- transform_preprocessor(preprocessor, data[assessment_rows, , drop = FALSE])
    analysis_y <- data$TARGET[analysis_rows]
    assessment_y <- data$TARGET[assessment_rows]
    balanced <- balance_training_data(
      analysis_x, analysis_y, config$imbalance[[1]], seed + fold
    )
    fitted <- fit_algorithm(
      balanced$x, balanced$y, config$algorithm[[1]], seed = seed + fold
    )
    probability <- predict_algorithm(fitted, assessment_x)
    metrics <- classification_metrics(assessment_y, probability)
    metrics$model_id <- config$model_id[[1]]
    metrics$fold <- fold
    fold_metrics[[fold]] <- metrics
    predictions[[fold]] <- data.frame(
      row_index = which(assessment_rows), fold = fold, truth = assessment_y,
      probability = probability, model_id = config$model_id[[1]]
    )
    rm(preprocessor, analysis_x, assessment_x, balanced, fitted)
    invisible(gc())
  }
  list(
    fold_metrics = do.call(rbind, fold_metrics),
    predictions = do.call(rbind, predictions)
  )
}

summarize_fold_metrics <- function(fold_metrics, registry = candidate_registry()) {
  metric_names <- c("roc_auc", "pr_auc", "accuracy", "sensitivity", "specificity")
  model_ids <- unique(fold_metrics$model_id)
  rows <- lapply(model_ids, function(model_id) {
    subset <- fold_metrics[fold_metrics$model_id == model_id, , drop = FALSE]
    output <- data.frame(model_id = model_id, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    for (metric in metric_names) {
      output[[paste0("mean_", metric)]] <- mean(subset[[metric]], na.rm = TRUE)
      output[[paste0("se_", metric)]] <- stats::sd(subset[[metric]], na.rm = TRUE) /
        sqrt(sum(!is.na(subset[[metric]])))
    }
    output
  })
  summary <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  summary <- merge(
    registry[, c("model_id", "model_label", "algorithm", "predictor_set", "imbalance")],
    summary, by = "model_id", all.y = TRUE, sort = FALSE
  )
  summary[order(summary$mean_roc_auc, decreasing = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
}

evaluate_candidates <- function(data, registry = candidate_registry(), v = 3L, seed = 6601L) {
  results <- vector("list", nrow(registry))
  names(results) <- registry$model_id
  for (index in seq_len(nrow(registry))) {
    message("Evaluating ", registry$model_label[[index]], "...")
    results[[index]] <- cross_validate_config(
      data, registry[index, , drop = FALSE], v = v, seed = seed
    )
  }
  fold_metrics <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results, `[[`, "fold_metrics"))
  predictions <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results, `[[`, "predictions"))
  list(
    results = results, fold_metrics = fold_metrics, predictions = predictions,
    summary = summarize_fold_metrics(fold_metrics, registry)
  )
}

best_candidate_config <- function(summary, registry = candidate_registry()) {
  best_id <- summary$model_id[[which.max(summary$mean_roc_auc)]]
  registry[registry$model_id == best_id, , drop = FALSE]
}

tuning_target_config <- function(best_config) {
  output <- best_config
  if (output$algorithm[[1]] == "logistic") {
    output$algorithm[[1]] <- "elastic_net"
    output$model_label[[1]] <- "Elastic-net extension of the best logistic model"
  }
  output
}

random_parameter_grid <- function(algorithm, size, predictor_count, seed = 6601L) {
  set.seed(seed)
  size <- as.integer(size)
  if (algorithm == "elastic_net") {
    return(data.frame(
      config_id = seq_len(size), alpha = stats::runif(size, 0, 1),
      lambda = 10^stats::runif(size, -5, -1)
    ))
  }
  if (algorithm == "random_forest") {
    return(data.frame(
      config_id = seq_len(size),
      ntree = sample(seq(200L, 800L, by = 25L), size, replace = TRUE),
      mtry = sample(seq_len(max(2L, min(80L, predictor_count))), size, replace = TRUE),
      nodesize = sample(5:50, size, replace = TRUE)
    ))
  }
  if (algorithm == "gbm") {
    return(data.frame(
      config_id = seq_len(size),
      n.trees = sample(seq(200L, 1000L, by = 25L), size, replace = TRUE),
      interaction.depth = sample(2:8, size, replace = TRUE),
      shrinkage = exp(stats::runif(size, log(0.01), log(0.15))),
      n.minobsinnode = sample(5:40, size, replace = TRUE),
      bag.fraction = stats::runif(size, 0.6, 1.0)
    ))
  }
  stop("No tuning grid is defined for: ", algorithm, call. = FALSE)
}

prepare_cv_matrices <- function(data, config, v = 3L, seed = 6601L) {
  folds <- make_stratified_folds(data$TARGET, v = v, seed = seed)
  lapply(seq_len(v), function(fold) {
    analysis_rows <- folds != fold
    assessment_rows <- folds == fold
    preprocessor <- fit_preprocessor(
      data[analysis_rows, , drop = FALSE], config$predictor_set[[1]]
    )
    list(
      analysis_x = transform_preprocessor(preprocessor, data[analysis_rows, , drop = FALSE]),
      analysis_y = data$TARGET[analysis_rows],
      assessment_x = transform_preprocessor(preprocessor, data[assessment_rows, , drop = FALSE]),
      assessment_y = data$TARGET[assessment_rows]
    )
  })
}

tune_candidate <- function(data, config, v = 3L, grid_size = 20L, seed = 6601L) {
  cv_data <- prepare_cv_matrices(data, config, v = v, seed = seed)
  grid <- random_parameter_grid(
    config$algorithm[[1]], grid_size, ncol(cv_data[[1]]$analysis_x), seed
  )
  fold_rows <- vector("list", nrow(grid) * v)
  position <- 1L
  for (grid_row in seq_len(nrow(grid))) {
    parameters <- as.list(grid[grid_row, setdiff(names(grid), "config_id"), drop = FALSE])
    message("Tuning configuration ", grid_row, " of ", nrow(grid), "...")
    for (fold in seq_len(v)) {
      balanced <- balance_training_data(
        cv_data[[fold]]$analysis_x, cv_data[[fold]]$analysis_y,
        config$imbalance[[1]], seed + grid_row * 100L + fold
      )
      fitted <- fit_algorithm(
        balanced$x, balanced$y, config$algorithm[[1]], parameters,
        seed + grid_row * 100L + fold
      )
      probability <- predict_algorithm(fitted, cv_data[[fold]]$assessment_x)
      metrics <- classification_metrics(cv_data[[fold]]$assessment_y, probability)
      metrics$config_id <- grid$config_id[[grid_row]]
      metrics$fold <- fold
      fold_rows[[position]] <- metrics
      position <- position + 1L
      rm(balanced, fitted)
      invisible(gc())
    }
  }
  fold_metrics <- do.call(rbind, fold_rows)
  config_ids <- unique(fold_metrics$config_id)
  summary_rows <- lapply(config_ids, function(config_id) {
    subset <- fold_metrics[fold_metrics$config_id == config_id, , drop = FALSE]
    data.frame(
      config_id = config_id,
      mean_roc_auc = mean(subset$roc_auc, na.rm = TRUE),
      se_roc_auc = stats::sd(subset$roc_auc, na.rm = TRUE) /
        sqrt(sum(!is.na(subset$roc_auc))),
      mean_pr_auc = mean(subset$pr_auc, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_accuracy = mean(subset$accuracy, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  })
  summary <- merge(grid, do.call(rbind, summary_rows), by = "config_id", sort = FALSE)
  summary <- summary[order(summary$mean_roc_auc, decreasing = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
  best_id <- summary$config_id[[1]]
  best_parameters <- as.list(
    grid[grid$config_id == best_id, setdiff(names(grid), "config_id"), drop = FALSE]
  )
  list(
    grid = grid, fold_metrics = fold_metrics, summary = summary,
    best_parameters = best_parameters, best_auc = summary$mean_roc_auc[[1]],
    config = config
  )
}

fit_final_model <- function(data, config, best_parameters, seed = 6601L) {
  preprocessor <- fit_preprocessor(data, config$predictor_set[[1]])
  x <- transform_preprocessor(preprocessor, data)
  balanced <- balance_training_data(x, data$TARGET, config$imbalance[[1]], seed)
  model <- fit_algorithm(
    balanced$x, balanced$y, config$algorithm[[1]], best_parameters, seed
  )
  list(preprocessor = preprocessor, model = model, config = config)
}

predict_final_model <- function(final_model, new_data) {
  x <- transform_preprocessor(final_model$preprocessor, new_data)
  predict_algorithm(final_model$model, x)
}

make_submission <- function(final_model, test, output_path) {
  assert_columns(test, "SK_ID_CURR", "test data")
  probability <- predict_final_model(final_model, test)
  submission <- data.frame(SK_ID_CURR = test$SK_ID_CURR, TARGET = probability)
  if (anyDuplicated(submission$SK_ID_CURR)) {
    stop("Submission contains duplicate SK_ID_CURR values.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (any(!is.finite(submission$TARGET)) || any(submission$TARGET < 0 | submission$TARGET > 1)) {
    stop("Submission probabilities must be finite and between 0 and 1.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  dir.create(dirname(output_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  data.table::fwrite(submission, output_path)
  submission
}

model_importance <- function(final_model, top_n = 20L) {
  algorithm <- final_model$model$algorithm
  feature_names <- final_model$preprocessor$feature_names
  if (algorithm == "logistic") {
    values <- abs(final_model$model$coefficients[-1])
    names(values) <- feature_names
  } else if (algorithm == "elastic_net") {
    coefficients <- as.matrix(stats::coef(
      final_model$model$fit, s = final_model$model$parameters$lambda
    ))
    values <- abs(coefficients[-1, 1])
    names(values) <- rownames(coefficients)[-1]
  } else if (algorithm == "random_forest") {
    importance <- randomForest::importance(final_model$model$fit)
    column <- if ("MeanDecreaseGini" %in% colnames(importance)) {
      "MeanDecreaseGini"
    } else {
      colnames(importance)[[ncol(importance)]]
    }
    values <- importance[, column]
    names(values) <- rownames(importance)
  } else if (algorithm == "gbm") {
    importance <- summary(final_model$model$fit, plotit = FALSE)
    values <- importance$rel.inf
    names(values) <- importance$var
  } else {
    return(data.frame(feature = character(), importance = numeric()))
  }
  values <- values[is.finite(values)]
  values <- head(sort(values, decreasing = TRUE), top_n)
  data.frame(feature = names(values), importance = as.numeric(values),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = NULL)
}

read_kaggle_score <- function(path = "config/kaggle_score.yml") {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(list(public_auc = NULL, notes = "Score file not found."))
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  read_value <- function(key) {
    line <- lines[grepl(paste0("^", key, ":"), lines)]
    if (length(line) == 0L) return(NULL)
    value <- trimws(sub(paste0("^", key, ":"), "", line[[1]]))
    value <- sub('^"', "", sub('"$', "", value))
    if (value %in% c("", "null", "NULL")) NULL else value
  }
  score <- read_value("public_auc")
  list(
    public_auc = if (is.null(score)) NULL else as.numeric(score),
    submission_name = read_value("submission_name"),
    submission_date = read_value("submission_date"),
    notes = read_value("notes")
  )
}

replace_marked_block <- function(lines, start_marker, end_marker, replacement) {
  start_index <- match(start_marker, lines)
  end_index <- match(end_marker, lines)
  if (is.na(start_index) || is.na(end_index) || end_index <= start_index) {
    stop("README markers were not found in the expected order.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  before <- if (start_index > 1L) lines[seq_len(start_index - 1L)] else character()
  after <- if (end_index < length(lines)) {
    lines[seq.int(end_index + 1L, length(lines))]
  } else {
    character()
  }
  c(before, start_marker, replacement, end_marker, after)
}

update_readme_model_results <- function(
    readme_path, majority_accuracy, best_candidate, best_auc,
    imbalance_strategy, feature_source, final_model_label, tuning_auc) {
  lines <- readLines(readme_path, warn = FALSE)
  replacement <- c(
    sprintf("- Majority-class accuracy: **%.4f**", majority_accuracy),
    "- Majority-class ROC AUC: **0.5000**",
    sprintf("- Best candidate model: **%s**", best_candidate),
    sprintf("- Best three-fold CV ROC AUC: **%.4f**", best_auc),
    sprintf("- Best gradient-boosting class strategy: **%s**", imbalance_strategy),
    sprintf("- Supplementary-feature decision: **%s**", feature_source),
    sprintf("- Final tuned model: **%s**", final_model_label),
    sprintf("- Best tuning-sample ROC AUC: **%.4f**", tuning_auc)
  )
  updated <- replace_marked_block(
    lines, "<!-- MODEL_RESULTS_START -->", "<!-- MODEL_RESULTS_END -->", replacement
  )
  writeLines(updated, readme_path)
  invisible(readme_path)
}
initialize_modeling_session(params$seed)
ensure_project_directories(
  project_path(params$outputs_dir),
  project_path(params$models_dir)
)
set.seed(params$seed)
```

The notebook writes resampling results, the fitted model, and the Kaggle submission only to ignored local folders. The Git repository therefore contains reproducible code but not large data or model artifacts.

## Data review and validation

### Competition tables

The availability check accepts both normal Kaggle filenames and duplicate browser-download names such as `bureau(1).csv`.

```{r}
#| label: data-inventory

data_inventory <- available_home_credit_files(project_path(params$data_dir))
inventory_display <- data_inventory[, c(
  "file", "grain", "primary_key", "join_key", "available"
)]

knitr::kable(
  inventory_display,
  col.names = c("File", "Row grain", "Candidate key", "Join key", "Available"),
  caption = "Home Credit tables and local availability"
)
```

`application_train.csv` and `application_test.csv` are required. Historical files are optional. The notebook uses whichever of `bureau.csv`, `previous_application.csv`, `installments_payments.csv`, `POS_CASH_balance.csv`, and `credit_card_balance.csv` are available.

`bureau_balance.csv` is unusually large, so its processing is disabled by default. Set `include_bureau_balance: true` only if the computer has enough memory. The less expensive `bureau.csv` aggregates are still used when available.

### Current applications

Prepared application files in `data/processed` are preferred when present; otherwise the raw Kaggle files are read. Deterministic features are created identically for train and test. These include age and employment duration in years, credit and annuity ratios, household-adjusted income, external-score summaries, and missingness counts.

```{r}
#| label: read-applications

application_data <- read_application_data(
  raw_dir = project_path(params$data_dir),
  processed_dir = project_path(params$processed_dir)
)

train_application <- engineer_application_features(application_data$train)
test_application <- engineer_application_features(application_data$test)
aligned_application <- harmonize_train_test(train_application, test_application)
train_application <- aligned_application$train
test_application <- aligned_application$test

application_summary <- data.frame(
  data_set = c("Training", "Test"),
  rows = c(nrow(train_application), nrow(test_application)),
  columns = c(ncol(train_application), ncol(test_application)),
  unique_applicants = c(
    length(unique(train_application$SK_ID_CURR)),
    length(unique(test_application$SK_ID_CURR))
  )
)

knitr::kable(
  application_summary,
  caption = "Application data after deterministic feature engineering"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: target-rate

target_counts <- table(train_application$TARGET)
target_summary <- data.frame(
  target = as.integer(names(target_counts)),
  applications = as.integer(target_counts),
  share = as.numeric(target_counts) / sum(target_counts)
)

knitr::kable(
  target_summary,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Training target distribution"
)
```

The observed default rate is `r sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * mean(train_application$TARGET == 1L))`. This imbalance is why ROC AUC, rather than accuracy, is the main comparison measure.

```{r}
engineered_names <- c(
```

## Supplementary features

Each historical table is summarized to the applicant level before joining. The cache avoids rebuilding several-million-row aggregates on every render. It is written under `data/processed`, which is excluded from Git.

```{r}
#| label: supplementary-features

supplementary_features <- NULL
supplementary_joined <- NULL

if (isTRUE(params$include_supplementary)) {
  cache_name <- if (isTRUE(params$include_bureau_balance)) {
    "supplementary_features_with_bureau_balance.csv"
  } else {
    "supplementary_features.csv"
  }
  supplementary_features <- load_or_build_supplementary_features(
    data_dir = project_path(params$data_dir),
    cache_path = project_path(file.path(params$processed_dir, cache_name)),
    include_bureau_balance = isTRUE(params$include_bureau_balance)
  )
}

if (!is.null(supplementary_features)) {
  supplementary_joined <- join_supplementary_features(
    train_application,
    test_application,
    supplementary_features
  )
  supplementary_summary <- data.frame(
    applicant_rows = nrow(supplementary_features),
    engineered_columns = ncol(supplementary_features) - 1L,
    train_rows_after_join = nrow(supplementary_joined$train)
  )
  knitr::kable(
    supplementary_summary,
    caption = "Applicant-level supplementary feature set"
  )
} else {
  cat("No supplementary table was found, so the comparison is skipped.\n")
}
```

## Performance benchmark

The majority-class classifier predicts non-default for every applicant. Its accuracy is high because defaults are uncommon, but its ROC AUC is 0.50 because a constant score cannot rank applicants.

```{r}
#| label: majority-baseline

benchmark <- baseline_metrics(train_application)
knitr::kable(
  benchmark,
  digits = 4,
  col.names = c("Benchmark", "Metric", "Estimate", "Meaning"),
  caption = "Majority-class performance benchmark"
)
```

## Candidate models and cross-validation

For a manageable exploratory run, I use a stratified sample of 50,000 rows for candidate comparison. Change `candidate_rows` to `0` to use all rows. Every model is evaluated on the same three stratified folds.

The candidates are:

- logistic regression with a focused predictor set;
- elastic-net logistic regression with all predictors;
- random forest;
- gradient boosting without resampling;
- gradient boosting with downsampling; and
- gradient boosting with upsampling.

Numeric missing values are filled with training-fold medians. Categorical values are replaced by their training-fold frequency, with unseen validation/test values assigned zero. This creates a compact numeric matrix without thousands of dummy variables.

```{r}
#| label: candidate-data

candidate_train <- if (
  params$candidate_rows > 0 && params$candidate_rows < nrow(train_application)
) {
  stratified_sample_rows(
    train_application,
    n = params$candidate_rows,
    seed = params$seed
  )
} else {
  train_application
}

candidate_sampling_note <- data.frame(
  full_training_rows = nrow(train_application),
  candidate_rows_used = nrow(candidate_train),
  cv_folds = params$cv_folds,
  default_rate = mean(candidate_train$TARGET == 1L)
)
knitr::kable(
  candidate_sampling_note,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Candidate-model computation settings"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: candidate-cv
#| cache: true

candidate_output <- evaluate_candidates(
  data = candidate_train,
  registry = candidate_registry(),
  v = params$cv_folds,
  seed = params$seed
)
candidate_summary <- candidate_output$summary

data.table::fwrite(
  candidate_summary,
  project_path(file.path(params$outputs_dir, "candidate_cv_summary.csv"))
)
saveRDS(
  candidate_output,
  project_path(file.path(params$outputs_dir, "candidate_cv_results.rds"))
)
```

```{r}
#| label: candidate-results

candidate_display <- candidate_summary[, c(
  "model_label", "imbalance", "mean_roc_auc", "se_roc_auc",
  "mean_pr_auc", "mean_accuracy", "mean_sensitivity", "mean_specificity"
)]
knitr::kable(
  candidate_display,
  digits = 4,
  col.names = c(
    "Model", "Class strategy", "ROC AUC", "SE", "PR AUC",
    "Accuracy", "Sensitivity", "Specificity"
  ),
  caption = "Three-fold cross-validation estimates"
)
```

```{r}

#| fig-height: 4.8

plot_values <- candidate_summary$mean_roc_auc[plot_order]
plot_labels <- candidate_summary$model_label[plot_order]
dotchart(
  plot_values,
  labels = plot_labels,
```

The best candidate by mean out-of-sample ROC AUC is **`r candidate_summary$model_label[[1]]`**, with estimated AUC **`r sprintf("%.4f", candidate_summary$mean_roc_auc[[1]])`**.

## Class-imbalance experiment

The next table holds the algorithm and features fixed and compares no resampling, downsampling, and upsampling. Resampling can improve sensitivity, but it does not automatically improve ranking AUC.

```{r}#| label: imbalance-results

imbalance_summary <- candidate_summary[
  candidate_summary$algorithm == "gbm",
  c("model_label", "imbalance", "mean_roc_auc", "mean_pr_auc",
    "mean_accuracy", "mean_sensitivity", "mean_specificity")
]
imbalance_summary <- imbalance_summary[
  order(imbalance_summary$mean_roc_auc, decreasing = TRUE),
]

knitr::kable(
  imbalance_summary,
  digits = 4,
  col.names = c(
    "Model", "Strategy", "ROC AUC", "PR AUC", "Accuracy",
    "Sensitivity", "Specificity"
  ),
  caption = "Gradient boosting with and without class adjustment"
)
```

The best boosting class strategy is **`r imbalance_summary$imbalance[[1]]`**. This strategy is selected on AUC, not on training class balance or raw accuracy.

## Supplementary-feature comparison

To make a fair application-only versus historical-data comparison, I use the highest-AUC candidate whose predictor set includes all columns. The same folds, algorithm, and class strategy are used for both versions.

```{r}
#| label: supplementary-comparison
#| cache: true

best_application_config <- best_candidate_config(candidate_summary)
selected_config <- best_application_config
selected_feature_source <- "Application features only"
selected_candidate_auc <- candidate_summary$mean_roc_auc[[1]]
supplementary_comparison <- NULL

if (!is.null(supplementary_joined)) {
  full_candidate_summary <- candidate_summary[
    candidate_summary$predictor_set == "full",
  ]
  full_candidate_summary <- full_candidate_summary[
    order(full_candidate_summary$mean_roc_auc, decreasing = TRUE),
  ]
  comparison_config <- candidate_registry()
  comparison_config <- comparison_config[
    comparison_config$model_id == full_candidate_summary$model_id[[1]],
    , drop = FALSE
  ]

  candidate_supplementary <- supplementary_joined$train[
    match(candidate_train$SK_ID_CURR, supplementary_joined$train$SK_ID_CURR),
    , drop = FALSE
  ]
  if (any(is.na(candidate_supplementary$SK_ID_CURR))) {
    stop("Applicant IDs were lost during the supplementary join.")
  }

  supplementary_cv <- cross_validate_config(
    candidate_supplementary,
    comparison_config,
    v = params$cv_folds,
    seed = params$seed
  )
  supplementary_auc <- mean(
    supplementary_cv$fold_metrics$roc_auc,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  application_full_auc <- full_candidate_summary$mean_roc_auc[[1]]
  supplementary_comparison <- data.frame(
    feature_set = c("Application only", "Application + historical aggregates"),
    model = comparison_config$model_label[[1]],
    mean_roc_auc = c(application_full_auc, supplementary_auc)
  )

  if (supplementary_auc > selected_candidate_auc) {
    selected_config <- comparison_config
    selected_feature_source <- "Application plus historical aggregate features"
    selected_candidate_auc <- supplementary_auc
  }

  data.table::fwrite(
    supplementary_comparison,
    project_path(file.path(params$outputs_dir, "supplementary_comparison.csv"))
  )
  saveRDS(
    supplementary_cv,
    project_path(file.path(params$outputs_dir, "supplementary_cv_results.rds"))
  )
  knitr::kable(
    supplementary_comparison,
    digits = 4,
    col.names = c("Feature set", "Fixed model", "Mean ROC AUC"),
    caption = "Effect of applicant-level historical aggregates"
  )
} else {
  cat("Supplementary features were unavailable, so application features are retained.\n")
}
```

The selected feature source is **`r selected_feature_source`**. It is retained only when its cross-validated AUC exceeds the best application-only candidate.

## Randomized hyperparameter tuning

The best selected model family is tuned with 20 randomly sampled parameter combinations, a stratified 5,000-row sample, and three-fold cross-validation. This follows the assignment's speed guidance and is much less expensive than an exhaustive grid.

If ordinary logistic regression was the leading candidate, tuning uses its elastic-net extension because unpenalized logistic regression has few meaningful hyperparameters.

```{r}
#| label: final-data-choice

if (identical(
  selected_feature_source,
  "Application plus historical aggregate features"
)) {
  final_train <- supplementary_joined$train
  final_test <- supplementary_joined$test
} else {
  final_train <- train_application
  final_test <- test_application
}

final_aligned <- harmonize_train_test(final_train, final_test)
final_train <- final_aligned$train
final_test <- final_aligned$test
tuning_config <- tuning_target_config(selected_config)

tuning_data <- stratified_sample_rows(
  final_train,
  n = params$tuning_rows,
  seed = params$seed + 1L
)

tuning_settings <- data.frame(
  model = tuning_config$model_label[[1]],
  algorithm = tuning_config$algorithm[[1]],
  class_strategy = tuning_config$imbalance[[1]],
  rows = nrow(tuning_data),
  folds = params$cv_folds,
  random_combinations = params$tuning_iterations
)
knitr::kable(tuning_settings, caption = "Randomized tuning settings")
```

```{r}
#| label: randomized-tuning
#| cache: true

tuning_output <- tune_candidate(
  data = tuning_data,
  config = tuning_config,
  v = params$cv_folds,
  grid_size = params$tuning_iterations,
  seed = params$seed + 2L
)

best_parameters <- tuning_output$best_parameters
data.table::fwrite(
  tuning_output$summary,
  project_path(file.path(params$outputs_dir, "randomized_tuning_results.csv"))
)
saveRDS(
  tuning_output,
  project_path(file.path(params$outputs_dir, "randomized_tuning_results.rds"))
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tuning-results

knitr::kable(
  head(tuning_output$summary, 10L),
  digits = 5,
  caption = "Top randomized-search configurations by validation ROC AUC"
)

best_parameter_table <- data.frame(
  parameter = names(best_parameters),
  value = as.character(unlist(best_parameters, use.names = FALSE))
)
knitr::kable(
  best_parameter_table,
  caption = "Selected hyperparameters"
)
```

The best tuning-sample ROC AUC is **`r sprintf("%.4f", tuning_output$best_auc)`**. Because this estimate is based on only 5,000 rows, it is used to choose hyperparameters rather than to claim the final model's definitive performance.

## Final model and variable importance

The selected model is now trained on the complete training data using preprocessing learned from that complete training set. The saved object includes both the fitted preprocessor and fitted model, so the identical transformations are applied to the test set.

```{r}
#| label: final-fit
#| cache: true

final_model <- fit_final_model(
  data = final_train,
  config = tuning_config,
  best_parameters = best_parameters,
  seed = params$seed + 3L
)
saveRDS(
  final_model,
  project_path(file.path(params$models_dir, "final_home_credit_model.rds"))
)

importance_table <- model_importance(final_model, top_n = 20L)
knitr::kable(
  importance_table,
  digits = 3,
  col.names = c("Feature", "Importance"),
  caption = "Top model-specific variable importance values"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: importance-plot
#| fig-height: 5.5

if (nrow(importance_table) > 0L) {
  display_importance <- importance_table[nrow(importance_table):1L, ]
  par(mar = c(5, 10, 3, 1))
  barplot(
    display_importance$importance,
    names.arg = display_importance$feature,
    horiz = TRUE,
    las = 1,
    border = NA,
    xlab = "Model-specific importance",
    main = "Most influential predictors"
  )
}
```

These importance values describe associations used by the fitted model. They do not establish that changing a feature would cause default risk to change.

## Reproducibility and limitations

```{r}
#| label: session-info

sessionInfo()
```

Cross-validation and a Kaggle score evaluate discrimination on this historical competition dataset. They do not establish future calibration, fairness across applicant groups, lending-policy impact, or causal effects. Frequency encoding is deliberately memory-efficient, but more elaborate encodings may improve predictive performance.
